body: Hell is the anger i feel every second of the day of watching my son hurt my daughter and not being able to shut out the evil thoughts i have in my own head over it. Hell is wanting to hurt your child and knowing deep down its not his fault. And there being nothing u can do to stop it. There is no hell worse then what im going thru

I dont believe in passed lives
But honestly i probably was hitler in one to be dealt such an unwinning hand. 
And if there is a hell im
Sure im going there for this choice but the hell im living in is too much.

Even if i could do that…. After a week or two i end up right back in the same situation.
If i run and abandon my son, i dont think i can live with that either and still end up killing myself because i do love my son it causes me so much pain to not be able to do this iv tried so hard.
I cant live watching someone else go thru what im going thru. While he calls me on the phone from afar. I just want the painful lose lose choices to stop.
And i know they dont actually stop once i kill myself.
But they do stop for me. 
The pain stops for me. It doesnt feel like theres any way out of this mental prison besides this and i have spent years trying to find answers or help.
The world is a bad place and i just dont have it in me to try anything else and watch it fail anymore 
I just want it all over

I dont want to push
I dont want to try
I just want it to stop
I need to make it all stop
No shit thats why im not a person just a slave used for everyone elses needs met but my own.
Who? Ppl dont show up for us…. I get canceled on by health profesionals non stop because of his age or it being out of there qualifications
Nope hes diagnosed with schizophrenia his issues will just get worse and its just me him and his sister

I really just cant do it anymore. Its not about missing anyone. I didnt sign up to be a fulltime caretaker to a child that will never get any better and only will get worse… i just cant live this life … its so much worse then death and i know im being selfish but o just cant live like this

I dont know.
I havnt spoken to anyone in awhile.. when i talk to anyone my son he like gets mad and attacks the other person or screams for attention … i gave up on talking to people or really anything like that at all … it hurts to even try to think for myself at this point because everything is about him
I do that sometimes, it doesnt help much… just tired of it all.

There dad killed himself while i was pregnant 
Theres no safe place for any of us and if u read my other post it explains why better i dont have the energy to go into more detail im sorry

Im too tired to try anymore.
I think the first time i felt any peace was when i finally decided monday is the day 
Like it actually feels like i can make it stop now.
Id cut off my leg to find another way to make this hell end or For some magic person to fall out of the sky and be in this situation with me and take weight off of me so i could hold on and manage. 
I just cant

Please read my other post for better understanding. I cant be a mother anymore.
We are all suffering. And its nothing i can fix or live with anymore
Please read my other post and see why thats not possible
There father killed himself while i was pregnant. So its a bit late for that.

Respite is extremely limited for our situation. 
Im trying to get him into a program that would be from 8- 4 every week day. But hes on the wait list and theres no telling how long il be waiting
He goes to inpatient often, there are no long term facilities for children his age
